lines: Winter is coming to the front. Before the snow buries it, the wire must be mended.
At night, men crawl out with coils of wire and iron posts. They work in the dark, without a sound.
When a flare goes up, they drop flat and wait for the dark.
The Hegemony wire is torn in twenty-eight places. Only fifty-eight percent still stands.
The Concord wire holds better, sixty-nine percent. But half of it is already sagging.
Wire stops a raid before it reaches the trench. Without it, every man on the fire step is easier to hit.
It is hard and dangerous work. A man on the wire is not on watch, and the enemy rifles never sleep.
Comment WIRE under this reel. Your soldier crawls out tonight and mends the wire in their own sector. Both sides can go.
Mud and Iron. Every follower is a soldier.
